info.title: Rightmo API
info.description: Version 1 of the shared Rightmo product catalog. All authenticated users have equal access.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Issue, inspect, and revoke eight-hour Sanctum bearer tokens.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: All authenticated users can manage shared categories. Only empty categories can be deleted.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: All authenticated users can read and modify the shared catalog.

tags.name: Product images
tags.description: One public image per product. Product data endpoints still require authentication.

default.description: Call POST /api/v1/auth/login to obtain data.token. Send it in the Authorization header. This API uses Sanctum bearer tokens, not cookie/CSRF authentication. The Next.js application separately keeps its token in an HttpOnly cookie.

post.description: Returns a new token. Invalid credentials return 401. Login is limited to five attempts per email/IP and 60 per IP each minute.

get.description:
Combine name search words in any order with multiple categories, price bounds, and a minimum rating.
Every search word must match; selected categories match any of the provided IDs.
Default ordering is newest first. All sort orders include an ID tie-breaker.
Pagination defaults to 12 items; per_page is capped at 100.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: All words must occur in the name, in any order (case insensitive). Up to 8 words; wildcard characters are literal. Must not be greater than 160 characters.

schema.description: All words must occur in the name, in any order (case insensitive). Up to 8 words; wildcard characters are literal. Must not be greater than 160 characters.

parameters.description: Legacy single category ID. Do not combine with category_ids. Must match an existing stored value.

schema.description: Legacy single category ID. Do not combine with category_ids. Must match an existing stored value.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum rating from 0 to 5, up to one decimal place. Must be between 0 and 5.

schema.description: Inclusive minimum rating from 0 to 5, up to one decimal place. Must be between 0 and 5.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum price (nonnegative, up to two decimal places). Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 9999999999.99.

schema.description: Inclusive minimum price (nonnegative, up to two decimal places). Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 9999999999.99.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Inclusive maximum price; must be greater than or equal to min_price. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 9999999999.99.

schema.description: Inclusive maximum price; must be greater than or equal to min_price. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 9999999999.99.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort by price or rating. Omit for newest first.

schema.description: Ascending or descending, defaults to desc. ID breaks ties.

parameters.name: page
